--------------------  ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
books                 CREATE TABLE books (                                                             
                          id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,                               
                          title       TEXT NOT NULL,                                                   
                          author      TEXT,                                                            
                          url         TEXT,                                                            
                          description TEXT                                                             
                      )                                                                                

career_nodes          CREATE TABLE "career_nodes" (                                                    
                          id        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,                                               
                          slug      TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,                                              
                          stream_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES streams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,         
                          parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES "career_nodes"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,           
                          name      TEXT NOT NULL,                                                     
                          intro     TEXT                                                               
                      )                                                                                

course_career_nodes   CREATE TABLE course_career_nodes (                                               
                                  course_id      INTEGER NOT NULL                                      
                                                     REFERENCES institute_courses(id)                  
                                                     ON DELETE CASCADE,                                
                                  node_id        INTEGER NOT NULL                                      
                                                     REFERENCES career_nodes(id)                       
                                                     ON DELETE CASCADE,                                
                                  relation       TEXT NOT NULL,                                        
                                  confidence     TEXT NOT NULL,                                        
                                  mapping_status TEXT NOT NULL,                                        
                                  PRIMARY KEY (course_id, node_id)                                     
                              )                                                                        

institute_categories  CREATE TABLE institute_categories (                                              
                                  institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL                                        
                                                   REFERENCES institutes(id)                           
                                                   ON DELETE CASCADE,                                  
                                  category     TEXT NOT NULL,                                          
                                  PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, category)                                 
                              )                                                                        

institute_courses     CREATE TABLE institute_courses (                                                 
                                  id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,               
                                  source_id           TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,                            
                                  institute_id        INTEGER NOT NULL                                 
                                                          REFERENCES institutes(id)                    
                                                          ON DELETE CASCADE,                           
                                  name                TEXT NOT NULL,                                   
                                  level               TEXT NOT NULL,                                   
                                  credential          TEXT,                                            
                                  specialization      TEXT,                                            
                                  duration            TEXT,                                            
                                  mode                TEXT,                                            
                                  eligibility         TEXT,                                            
                                  official_course_url TEXT NOT NULL,                                   
                                  verification_status TEXT NOT NULL                                    
                              , mapping_gap TEXT)                                                      

institute_rankings    CREATE TABLE institute_rankings (                                                
                                  institute_id      INTEGER NOT NULL                                   
                                                        REFERENCES institutes(id)                      
                                                        ON DELETE CASCADE,                             
                                  system            TEXT NOT NULL,                                     
                                  year              INTEGER NOT NULL,                                  
                                  category          TEXT NOT NULL,                                     
                                  nirf_institute_id TEXT,                                              
                                  rank              INTEGER,                                           
                                  rank_band         TEXT,                                              
                                  score             REAL,                                              
                                  source_url        TEXT NOT NULL,                                     
                                  PRIMARY KEY (institute_id, system, year, category)                   
                              )                                                                        

institutes            CREATE TABLE institutes (                                                        
                          id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,                               
                          name        TEXT NOT NULL,                                                   
                          city        TEXT,                                                            
                          website     TEXT,                                                            
                          description TEXT                                                             
                      , source_id TEXT, district TEXT, state TEXT)                                     

job_sectors           CREATE TABLE job_sectors (                                                       
                          id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,                               
                          name        TEXT NOT NULL,                                                   
                          description TEXT                                                             
                      )                                                                                

node_books            CREATE TABLE node_books (                                                        
                          node_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,     
                          book_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES books(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,            
                          PRIMARY KEY (node_id, book_id)                                               
                      )                                                                                

node_institutes       CREATE TABLE node_institutes (                                                   
                          node_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
                          institute_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES institutes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,   
                          PRIMARY KEY (node_id, institute_id)                                          
                      )                                                                                

node_job_sectors      CREATE TABLE node_job_sectors (                                                  
                          node_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES career_nodes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
                          job_sector_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES job_sectors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
                          PRIMARY KEY (node_id, job_sector_id)                                         
                      )                                                                                

sqlite_sequence       CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)                                           

streams               CREATE TABLE streams (                                                           
                          id    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,                                     
                          slug  TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,                                                  
                          name  TEXT NOT NULL,                                                         
                          intro TEXT                                                                   
                      )
